svg.title: A precognition court for AI
svg.desc: People review cases, hear objections and deliberately amend rules outside the acting AI’s control. The applicable rules and an AI proposal enter an independent check, which permits or refuses under current rules. The action must pass through an unavoidable permission path. Dashed paths record the decision and observed outcome in a shared record of proposal, rule version, decision and result, then carry cases back to people for review.
